definitions.explanation: The fish, especially the chum salmon (Oncorhynchus keta) native to Japanese waters. One of the most important food fish in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}は{焼|や}き{鮭|ざけ}と{味噌汁|みそしる}だった。
examples.english: This morning I had grilled salmon and miso soup.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}の{川|かわ}では{秋|あき}になると{鮭|さけ}が{遡上|そじょう}してくる。
examples.english: In autumn, salmon swim upstream in the rivers of Hokkaido.

notes:
The standard word for salmon in Japanese. The reading さけ is the most common, though しゃけ is also widely used in everyday speech, especially in eastern Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼|や}き{鮭|ざけ} — grilled salmon
- {鮭|さけ}の{切|き}り{身|み} — salmon fillet
- {鮭|さけ}フレーク — salmon flakes
- {鮭|さけ}おにぎり — salmon rice ball
- {鮭|さけ}とば — dried salmon strips (Hokkaido specialty)

PRONUNCIATION NOTE:
Both さけ and しゃけ are correct. In compound words, the reading often becomes ざけ (e.g., {焼|や}き{鮭|ざけ}, {塩|しお}{鮭|ざけ}).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サーモン — salmon (used for raw/sashimi preparations, often referring to farmed Atlantic salmon)
- {鱒|ます} — trout (a related but distinct fish)
